endpoint: Patton Park / Campbell’s Bridge river access

sources.supports: Adopted comprehensive-plan record identifying Patton Park as an anchor/regional park with Appomattox River Trail, fishing access, and a natural kayak/canoe launch.
Prior comprehensive-plan access table describing public Patton Park waterfront access and multiple paved ramps to the Appomattox River.

sources.publisher: Friends of the Lower Appomattox River
sources.supports: Independent trail guidance identifying Patton Park as the flatwater start of the lower Appomattox River Trail.

sourceAssessment: The city planning record is the controlling public-access evidence; the prior plan and FOLAR page corroborate the waterfront and paddling use. These sources support an access-area anchor, not an exact wet-toe coordinate.
